items.title: Rudy Van Gelder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And he got up and he said, “Come on up, play with the band,” and he gets somebody’s trumpet and hands it to him. He was sitting in the section! (Laughs)

ctx.x: When I was a kid, trumpet, in high school band. I was terrible
You played with a professional band once, didn’t you?
